title: Shape generation spec, version 1
description: A generation spec: a model (seed, locale, date range, mode), tables whose columns each carry a generator (a strategy name plus the keys that strategy reads), relationships, business rules, scale presets and derived row counts, and correlated column pairs. Stable within 1.x (docs/GENERATION_SPEC.md): keys and strategies are only ever added.

correlated_columns.description: table -> [column_a, column_b, r] triples for the Gaussian-copula post-pass.

generator.description: A strategy name plus the keys that strategy reads. A strategy that is not built in (a plugin's) accepts any keys.

max_length.description: Written by older tools and ignored by the strategy.

type.description: Written by older tools and ignored by the strategy.
